articleSections.headline: Understanding Vitamin C and Its Importance
articleSections.content: Vitamin C is a powerful antioxidant that plays a vital role in immune function. It helps protect cells from oxidative stress and supports the production of white blood cells, which are essential for fighting infections.

articleSections.content: The effectiveness of Thorne Vitamin C with Flavonoids can be attributed to several well-established physiological mechanisms: Multi-Supplement Protocol that Comprehensive daily immune support are helpful to enhancing immune health, energy, and overall wellness. 1. Enhanced Absorption: The presence of flavonoids can improve the absorption of vitamin C in the intestines. This means that you may receive more of the beneficial effects of vitamin C when taken in conjunction with flavonoids. 2. Increased Antioxidant Capacity: The combination of vitamin C and flavonoids provides a robust defense against oxidative stress. While vitamin C directly neutralizes free radicals, flavonoids can regenerate vitamin C, allowing it to continue its antioxidant work. 3. Flavonoids may further support immune function by modulating inflammatory responses, potentially leading to a more balanced immune system. 4.
